operating_income.source: Operating income not reported in XBRL by deskstack (null). Proxy = pretax income (IncomeLossFromContinuingOperationsBeforeIncomeTaxes...: 1,889/19,936/21,067) + interest expense (1,146/1,271/1,357), acc. 0000310158-26-000063 (FY23 interest from 0001628280-24-006850). Approximation; excludes other income/expense netting. FY2023 depressed by large acquisition charges.

d_and_a.source: us-gaap:Depreciation (1,828/2,104/3,045) + AmortizationOfIntangibleAssets (2,000/2,400/2,800; rounded as reported), acc. 0000310158-26-000063

revenue_growth.source: Assumption: FY23-25 CAGR ~4%; moderated for Keytruda patent expiry ~2028 offset by Winrevair/pipeline and new launches.

ebit_margin.source: Assumption: FY2025 proxy margin 34.5% (pretax+interest); haircut for Keytruda LOE, acquisition/IPR&D charges that recur, and proxy overstatement of other income.

tax_rate.source: Assumption: FY2025 effective rate approx 13% (pretax 21,067 vs net income 18,254); raised toward ~16% for Pillar Two/mix normalization.

wacc.source: Assumption via CAPM: Rf 4.86% (US Treasury 10Y, 2026-11-06) + beta ~0.8 (assumed, large-cap pharma; not retrieved from Damodaran) x ERP 4.46% (Damodaran US, 2026-02-16) = ~8.4% cost of equity; after-tax cost of debt ~4.5% at ~25% debt weight gives ~7.5%.

terminal_growth.source: Assumption: below risk-free rate and long-run nominal GDP; mature pharma.

net_debt.source: financial_statements derived net_debt = total debt 49,339 (LTD noncurrent 46,750 + current debt 2,589) - cash 14,565 - ST investments 0; acc. 0000310158-26-000063
